requirement_text: For the CNG management it is recommended to use a single protocol, so as to minimize the complexity and the cost of the service.
user_story: As a network administrator, I want a single protocol used for CNG management, so that complexity and cost of the service are kept low.
technical_task: Use one protocol for the CNG management in place of several.
acceptance_criteria: Given the CNG management, when it is configured, then a single protocol is used.
Given the CNG management service, when its design is reviewed, then it does not need a second management protocol.
rationale: Role assumed: network administrator. The requirement says "recommended"; it is treated as the preferred design, not as a measured limit on cost.

requirement_text: Intermediate files of cleaned-up ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry shall be generated in the event that cleaned-up telemetry is not provided by ESOC.
user_story: As a data processing engineer, I want intermediate files of cleaned-up ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry generated when ESOC does not supply cleaned-up telemetry, so that processing can continue.
technical_task: Generate intermediate files of cleaned-up ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry whenever cleaned-up telemetry is not provided by ESOC.
acceptance_criteria: Given cleaned-up telemetry is not provided by ESOC, when processing starts, then intermediate files of cleaned-up ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry are generated.
Given cleaned-up telemetry is provided by ESOC, when processing starts, then the intermediate files are not needed.
rationale: Role assumed: data processing engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "in the event that".

requirement_text: The system shall offer comprehensive online help and documentation for users of all skill levels.
rationale: "Comprehensive" and "all skill levels" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What topics and formats must the online help and documentation cover?
How is "comprehensive" and "all skill levels" measured?

requirement_text: The system shall allow filtering and ranking videos based on audio/visual quality.
user_story: As a user, I want to filter and rank videos by audio and visual quality, so that I can find the best ones.
technical_task: Provide filtering and ranking of videos by audio quality and visual quality.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of videos, when the user filters by audio or visual quality, then only matching videos are shown.
Given a list of videos, when the user ranks by audio or visual quality, then the videos are ordered by that quality.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The quality scale is not given.

requirement_text: Bidders shall be able to view the team leaderboard in ascending order of points and use the information for bidding decisions.
user_story: As a bidder, I want to view the team leaderboard in ascending order of points, so that I can make bidding decisions.
technical_task: Display the team leaderboard sorted by points in ascending order for bidders.
acceptance_criteria: Given the team leaderboard, when a bidder opens it, then teams are listed in ascending order of points.
Given a bidder viewing the leaderboard, when the bidder reads it, then the points of each team are visible for bidding decisions.
rationale: Role stated: bidder.

requirement_text: System shall be optimized for fast loading on supported devices.
rationale: "Fast loading" is not measurable and the supported devices are not listed.
clarification_questions: What load time target applies on supported devices?

requirement_text: Each message element of a transaction should be loggable each time it enters or leaves a host system of the solution.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want each message element of a transaction to be loggable when it enters or leaves a host system, so that transactions can be traced.
technical_task: Allow logging of every message element of a transaction each time it enters or leaves a host system of the solution.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message element of a transaction, when it enters a host system, then it can be logged.
Given a message element of a transaction, when it leaves a host system, then it can be logged.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer.

requirement_text: System shall automatically generate mark sheets for students in different semesters.
user_story: As a student, I want mark sheets generated automatically for each semester, so that I get my results without manual work.
technical_task: Generate mark sheets automatically for students for each of their semesters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a student with results in a semester, when the mark sheet is requested, then it is generated automatically.
Given results from different semesters, when mark sheets are generated, then one is produced per semester.
rationale: Role assumed: student.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall give tasks priority values according to their rate - the higher the rate, the higher the priority.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS027] give tasks priority values according to their rate - the higher the rate, the higher the priority.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to give higher priority to tasks with higher rates, so that faster tasks run first.
technical_task: Assign task priority values in the scheduler according to task rate, with a higher rate giving a higher priority.
acceptance_criteria: Given two tasks with different rates, when the scheduler assigns priorities, then the task with the higher rate gets the higher priority.
Given tasks with the same rate, when the scheduler assigns priorities, then they get the same priority value.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The information extraction unit shall populate the database before system startup to ensure immediate data accessibility.
user_story: As a user, I want the database filled before the system starts, so that data is available immediately.
technical_task: Run the information extraction unit to populate the database before system startup.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is about to start, when the information extraction unit has run, then the database is populated.
Given the system has started, when data is requested, then it is accessible immediately.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: System shall process up to 50 tasks per second to maintain operational efficiency.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the system to process up to 50 tasks per second, so that operations stay efficient.
technical_task: Process a load of up to 50 tasks per second.
acceptance_criteria: Given a load of 50 tasks per second, when the system processes the tasks, then all of them are processed.
Given a load below 50 tasks per second, when the system processes the tasks, then all of them are processed.
rationale: Role assumed: operations manager.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to allow any faculty member to add inventory for all departments they have access to.
user_story: As a faculty member, I want to add inventory for every department I have access to, so that each department's stock is recorded.
technical_task: Let a faculty member add inventory items for each department that the member can access.
acceptance_criteria: Given a faculty member with access to several departments, when the member adds inventory for one of them, then the inventory is saved for that department.
Given a department the faculty member cannot access, when the member tries to add inventory, then it is refused.
rationale: Role stated: faculty member.

requirement_text: The manager shall view sales statistics in various formats such as pie charts, bar graphs, and tabular formats.
user_story: As a manager, I want to view sales statistics as pie charts, bar graphs or tables, so that I can read them in the form I prefer.
technical_task: Present sales statistics in several formats including pie charts, bar graphs and tabular form.
acceptance_criteria: Given sales statistics, when the manager chooses a pie chart, then they are shown as a pie chart.
Given sales statistics, when the manager chooses a bar graph or a table, then they are shown in that format.
rationale: Role stated: manager.

requirement_text: Each MPCC is configured to halt processing if any of the MPE tests, listed in Table 3.2-5, fails.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want each MPCC to halt processing when any MPE test fails, so that faults stop further operation.
technical_task: Configure every MPCC to halt processing if any MPE test in the referenced table fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given an MPCC is running the MPE tests, when any test fails, then the MPCC halts processing.
Given an MPCC is running the MPE tests, when all tests pass, then the MPCC continues processing.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The list of MPE tests is in a table that is not part of the requirement text.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to search for videos using keywords or other criteria.
user_story: As a user, I want to search videos by keywords or other criteria, so that I can find them easily.
technical_task: Provide video search that accepts keywords and further search criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given a keyword, when the user searches, then matching videos are listed.
Given another search criterion, when the user searches, then matching videos are listed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The other criteria are not listed.

requirement_text: System shall allow users to participate in online discussions about LPG.
user_story: As a user, I want to join online discussions about LPG, so that I can exchange views with others.
technical_task: Provide online discussions about LPG in which users can take part.
acceptance_criteria: Given a discussion about LPG, when the user posts a message, then it is added to the discussion.
Given a discussion about LPG, when the user opens it, then the messages of others are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: User shall have access to the WhatsApp internal server, which must be available 24/7.
user_story: As a user, I want access to the WhatsApp internal server at all times, so that my service is not interrupted.
technical_task: Keep the WhatsApp internal server available 24/7 and accessible to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given the WhatsApp internal server, when a user requests access at any hour, then access is available 24/7.
Given a period of operation, when availability is checked, then no scheduled downtime is allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation of 24/7.

requirement_text: Overrating of small dips (zero values) in the antenna pattern can be avoided by use of the cumulative distribution function.
rationale: The sentence is a remark about a possible technique and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a note on how to evaluate the antenna pattern?
What must the system do with the cumulative distribution function?

requirement_text: For reserved exceptions, the FTPP system shall “handle” the exception by making the error and its context data available to the application and then returning from the exception handler.
requirement_text_raw: For reserved exceptions, the FTPP system shall (3.3.12.6) “handle” the exception by making the error and its context data available to the application and then returning from the exception handler.
user_story: As a software developer, I want reserved exceptions handled by passing the error and its context data to the application and returning from the handler, so that the application can react.
technical_task: Handle a reserved exception in the FTPP system by making the error and its context data available to the application and then returning from the exception handler.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reserved exception occurs, when the FTPP system handles it, then the error and its context data are made available to the application.
Given the error and context data have been made available, when the handling ends, then the exception handler returns.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer.

requirement_text: The system shall provide users with a list of selectable symptoms.
user_story: As a patient, I want a list of symptoms to choose from, so that I can describe how I feel.
technical_task: Display a list of selectable symptoms.
acceptance_criteria: Given the symptom list, when the user opens it, then selectable symptoms are shown.
Given the symptom list, when the user selects a symptom, then it is marked as chosen.
rationale: Role assumed: patient.

requirement_text: For all objects, the angle between the connecting lines from left edge point to middle edge point and from middle edge point to right edge point shall be not larger than 180° (acute angle), as seen from the system vehicle, i.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the angle between the edge point connecting lines of each object to be no larger than 180°, so that objects have an acute shape from the vehicle's viewpoint.
technical_task: Ensure that for every object the angle between the line from the left edge point to the middle edge point and the line from the middle edge point to the right edge point is not larger than 180°, seen from the system vehicle.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object, when the angle between the two connecting lines is measured from the system vehicle, then it is not larger than 180°.
Given an object with an angle larger than 180°, when it is checked, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. The source text ends in a cut-off "i.".

requirement_text: The system shall allow a Member State to ask for the status of card (lost, stolen) to the corresponding Card Issuing Authority of the ember State having issued the card.
user_story: As a Member State official, I want to ask the Card Issuing Authority of the issuing Member State for the status of a card, so that I know whether it is lost or stolen.
technical_task: Provide a request from a Member State to the corresponding Card Issuing Authority for the status of a card, such as lost or stolen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a card issued by another Member State, when a Member State asks for its status, then the request goes to the corresponding Card Issuing Authority.
Given a status request, when the authority answers, then the status of the card, for example lost or stolen, is returned.
rationale: Role assumed: Member State official.

requirement_text: See SPEC LV 123 (`` Reference List for Client Specifications '' [HVBATT R-111]) for details.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced Reference List for Client Specifications require?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: User shall expect the system to recover to a stable state within 5 minutes in the event of a system failure.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to recover to a stable state within 5 minutes after a failure, so that I can continue working.
technical_task: Return the system to a stable state within 5 minutes of a system failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a system failure, when recovery runs, then the system is in a stable state within 5 minutes.
Given a recovery that takes longer than 5 minutes, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What counts as a stable state is not defined.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to mark an item as a favorite for change notifications.
user_story: As a user, I want to mark an item as a favorite, so that I get change notifications for it.
technical_task: Provide a favorite marker on items that enables notifications about changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item, when the user marks it as a favorite, then it is flagged as a favorite.
Given a favorite item, when it changes, then a change notification is sent to the user.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The NE syndromes shall include indications of vote errors, fault-tolerant clock synchronization errors, and fiber-optic link errors, as detailed below.
requirement_text_raw: The NE syndromes shall (3.2.2.6.3) include indications of vote errors, fault-tolerant clock synchronization errors, and fiber-optic link errors, as detailed below.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the NE syndromes to include vote errors, clock synchronization errors and fiber-optic link errors, so that these faults can be diagnosed.
technical_task: Include indications of vote errors, fault-tolerant clock synchronization errors and fiber-optic link errors in the NE syndromes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vote error, when the NE syndromes are read, then it is indicated.
Given a fault-tolerant clock synchronization error or a fiber-optic link error, when the NE syndromes are read, then it is indicated.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "As detailed below" refers to text that is not included.

requirement_text: Power de-coupling mechanisms shall be designed into the NE.
requirement_text_raw: Power de-coupling mechanisms shall (3.2.3.1.2.4) be designed into the NE.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want power de-coupling mechanisms designed into the NE, so that power disturbances are limited.
technical_task: Design power de-coupling mechanisms into the NE.
acceptance_criteria: Given the NE design, when it is reviewed, then power de-coupling mechanisms are included.
Given the NE hardware, when it is inspected, then the mechanisms are present.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer.

requirement_text: All account IDs that are used by the System are identified and the resources accessed by each account is known.
user_story: As a security officer, I want all account IDs used by the system identified and the resources each account accesses known, so that access can be audited.
technical_task: Identify every account ID the System uses and record the resources that each account accesses.
acceptance_criteria: Given the System, when its accounts are reviewed, then all account IDs it uses are identified.
Given an account ID, when it is reviewed, then the resources it accesses are known.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer.

requirement_text: System shall maintain data integrity by preventing data loss through proper database management.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want data loss prevented through proper database management, so that data stays intact.
technical_task: Prevent loss of data by managing the database properly, including integrity protection.
acceptance_criteria: Given a database operation, when it completes, then no stored data is lost.
Given an interrupted operation, when the database is restored, then data integrity is maintained.
rationale: Role assumed: database administrator. "Proper" management practices are not listed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to place data under embargo to protect rights of first use and confidentiality responsibilities.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to place data under embargo, so that rights of first use and confidentiality are protected.
technical_task: Provide an embargo function for data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when the user places it under embargo, then the data is withheld from others.
Given an embargoed dataset, when another user requests it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: researcher. The second criterion is an interpretation of embargo.

requirement_text: User shall be able to return to the product category page using the back button in the top corner.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to go back to the product category page with the back button in the top corner, so that I can keep browsing.
technical_task: Place a back button in the top corner that returns the user to the product category page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a page, when the user selects the back button in the top corner, then the product category page is shown.
Given the page, when it is displayed, then the back button is in the top corner.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. Which corner is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall maintain low latency for a responsive user experience.
rationale: "Low latency" and "responsive" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: Under what load and for which operations is latency measured?

requirement_text: The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80\% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'
user_story: As a user, I want feedback from the product when needed, so that I know my actions were confirmed.
technical_task: Give feedback on user actions and confirm them accurately, so that 80% of surveyed users report accurate confirmations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user action, when feedback is necessary, then the product gives feedback.
Given a survey of users, when the results are counted, then at least 80% report that the product accurately confirms their actions.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The 80% figure is taken from the requirement.

requirement_text: For further details see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Wireless Subsystem" .
requirement_text_raw: For further details see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Wireless Subsystem" [RD3651].
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced System Specification require?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: If a user account is revoked it can only be re-instantiated by the System Administrator.
requirement_text_raw: If a user account is revoked  it can only be re-instantiated by the System Administrator.'
user_story: As a system administrator, I want to be the only one who can re-instantiate a revoked user account, so that revoked accounts stay closed.
technical_task: Restrict re-instantiation of a revoked user account to the System Administrator.
acceptance_criteria: Given a revoked user account, when the System Administrator re-instantiates it, then the account is active again.
Given a revoked user account, when anyone else tries to re-instantiate it, then it is refused.
rationale: Role stated: System Administrator.

requirement_text: System shall be able to connect to power through an electrical outlet and support network connections via Ethernet port and serial port jack.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the system to connect to mains through an outlet and to networks through an Ethernet port and a serial port jack, so that it can be powered and networked.
technical_task: Provide a connection to an electrical outlet for power, an Ethernet port and a serial port jack for network connections.
acceptance_criteria: Given an electrical outlet, when the system is connected, then it is powered.
Given an Ethernet port or a serial port jack, when a network cable is connected, then a network connection is supported.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer.

requirement_text: The Contractor shall add necessary implementation details to the Specification.
rationale: "Necessary implementation details" are not defined.
clarification_questions: In which section of the Specification must they be added?

requirement_text: The system shall be multilingual, supporting English, Turkish, Finnish, and Italian for international deployment.
user_story: As an international user, I want the system in English, Turkish, Finnish or Italian, so that I can use my language.
technical_task: Support the languages English, Turkish, Finnish and Italian.
acceptance_criteria: Given the language selection, when the user chooses Turkish, Finnish or Italian, then the interface is shown in that language.
Given the language selection, when the user chooses English, then the interface is shown in English.
rationale: Role assumed: international user.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner shall utilize scalable hosting solutions that can handle spikes in traffic without sacrificing performance.
user_story: As a parent, I want Crafty kids corner hosted on scalable hosting that copes with traffic spikes, so that the site stays usable.
technical_task: Host Crafty kids corner on scalable hosting that handles spikes in traffic without a loss of performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a spike in traffic, when users access Crafty kids corner, then the site stays available.
Given a spike in traffic, when users use the site, then performance does not drop.
rationale: Role assumed: parent. The size of a spike and the performance level are not given.

requirement_text: System shall/will identify dependencies on external services or APIs.
user_story: As a developer, I want the dependencies on external services or APIs identified, so that I know what the system relies on.
technical_task: Identify and list the external services and APIs the system depends on.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when its design is analysed, then the dependencies on external services are identified.
Given the system, when its design is analysed, then the dependencies on external APIs are identified.
rationale: Role assumed: developer.

requirement_text: A chef shall be able to indicate that a customers order item is ready to be served through a display.
user_story: As a chef, I want to mark a customer's order item as ready to serve on a display, so that waiters know to collect it.
technical_task: Provide a display function with which a chef flags an order item as ready to be served.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order item on the display, when the chef marks it as ready, then it is flagged as ready to be served.
Given an item flagged as ready, when the display is viewed, then the item is shown as ready.
rationale: Role stated: chef.

requirement_text: The program shall be free software for maximum public benefit through unrestricted redistribution.
user_story: As a user, I want the program released as free software, so that anyone may redistribute it without restriction.
technical_task: Distribute the program as free software with unrestricted redistribution.
acceptance_criteria: Given the program, when it is released, then it is under a free software licence.
Given a recipient of the program, when the recipient redistributes it, then no restriction prevents this.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Maximum public benefit" is not tested.

requirement_text: The administrator chooses a drug from each list to record an interaction between the two drugs.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to record an interaction by picking one drug from each of two lists, so that interactions are stored.
technical_task: Provide two drug lists from which the administrator picks one drug each to record an interaction between them.
acceptance_criteria: Given two drug lists, when the administrator chooses a drug from each, then an interaction between the two drugs is recorded.
Given a recorded interaction, when it is viewed, then both drugs are shown.
rationale: Role stated: administrator.

requirement_text: User shall be able to add inventory assets, with DA group members or authorized inventory group members adding assets owned by the department.
user_story: As a DA group member, I want to add inventory assets owned by my department, so that its assets are recorded.
technical_task: Allow inventory assets to be added by DA group members or authorized inventory group members for assets owned by the department.
acceptance_criteria: Given a DA group member or an authorized inventory group member, when the member adds an asset owned by the department, then the asset is saved.
Given a user outside these groups, when the user tries to add an asset, then it is refused.
rationale: Role stated: DA group member.

requirement_text: The system shall function reliably, with few or no interruptions in its first operational year and fewer still thereafter.
rationale: "Few", "fewer still" and "reliably" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: How many interruptions are "few" in the first operational year and how many are "fewer still" later?

requirement_text: A customer shall not be able to dismiss their engaged menu while there is a non-empty pending order associated with the engaged menu.
requirement_text_raw: A customer shall not be able to dismiss their engaged menu while there is a  non-empty pending order associated with the engaged menu.
user_story: As a customer, I want my engaged menu protected from dismissal while there is a pending order on it, so that I do not lose an order.
technical_task: Block the dismissal of an engaged menu when a non-empty pending order is associated with it.
acceptance_criteria: Given an engaged menu with a non-empty pending order, when the customer tries to dismiss it, then it is not dismissed.
Given an engaged menu with no pending order, when the customer dismisses it, then it is dismissed.
rationale: Role stated: customer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: System shall enable users to export their stories to their gallery and share them directly to social media platforms with ease.
user_story: As a user, I want to export my stories to my gallery and share them directly to social media, so that I can keep and show them.
technical_task: Provide export of stories to the gallery and direct sharing to social media platforms.
acceptance_criteria: Given a story, when the user exports it, then it is saved to the gallery.
Given a story, when the user shares it to a social media platform, then it is posted there directly.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "With ease" is not measurable and is not tested.

requirement_text: The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.'
user_story: As a viewer, I want the website to keep working when the streaming server goes down, so that I can still use it.
technical_task: Keep the website operating when the streaming server is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the streaming server is down, when a viewer uses the website, then the website continues to operate.
Given the streaming server is down, when a viewer opens a page that needs streaming, then the website still responds.
rationale: Role assumed: viewer. Which functions continue is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to transfer funds between their own accounts or to others accounts.
user_story: As a bank customer, I want to transfer funds between my own accounts or to other people's accounts, so that I can move money.
technical_task: Support fund transfers between a user's own accounts and to the accounts of others.
acceptance_criteria: Given two of the user's own accounts, when the user transfers funds, then the amount moves between them.
Given another person's account, when the user transfers funds, then the amount is sent to that account.
rationale: Role assumed: bank customer.

requirement_text: VC exchanges data as shortly described in the following.
rationale: The sentence is an introduction to a description and states no requirement.
clarification_questions: What data does VC exchange and with whom?
What does the description that follows contain?
